operations.raw_sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT c.subscription, c.change_type, c.locked_rate, c.currency,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.subscription ORDER BY c.effective_at DESC, c.creation DESC) AS rn
  FROM `tabSubscription Change` c
  WHERE c.change_type IN ('Created', 'Plan Changed', 'Cancelled')
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.currency = 'INR' THEN l.locked_rate ELSE 0 END), 0) AS run_rate_inr,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.currency = 'USD' THEN l.locked_rate ELSE 0 END), 0) AS run_rate_usd
FROM latest l
JOIN `tabSubscription` s ON s.name = l.subscription
WHERE l.rn = 1 AND l.change_type != 'Cancelled' AND s.enabled = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabTax Profile` tp WHERE tp.team = s.team AND tp.is_internal = 1)

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabWebhook Event` WHERE status = 'Failed'
    OR (status = 'Received' AND creation < NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)) AS webhooks_stuck,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabInvoice` WHERE erpnext_sync_status = 'Failed') AS sync_failed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabInvoice` WHERE status = 'Draft' AND hold_reason IS NOT NULL AND hold_reason != '') AS on_hold,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabSubscription` WHERE enabled = 1 AND account_standing IN ('Past Due', 'Suspended')) AS past_due,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabSubscription` WHERE enabled = 1) AS subscriptions,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) FROM `tabCredit Wallet` WHERE currency = 'INR') AS wallet_inr

billing-invoiced-and-collected-by-month-.name: billing-invoiced-and-collected-by-month-inr-query

operations.raw_sql:
SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(period_start), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(period_start) - 1 DAY) AS month,
  SUM(total) AS invoiced, SUM(amount_paid + credit_applied) AS collected
FROM `tabInvoice`
WHERE invoice_type = 'Billable' AND status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Waived') AND currency = 'INR'
  AND period_start >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

operations.raw_sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT c.subscription, c.change_type, c.locked_rate, c.currency,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.subscription ORDER BY c.effective_at DESC, c.creation DESC) AS rn
  FROM `tabSubscription Change` c
  WHERE c.change_type IN ('Created', 'Plan Changed', 'Cancelled')
),
metal AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(cost_per_month_inr) AS cost, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus,
    SUM(memory_gib) AS memory_gib, SUM(disk_gib) AS disk_gib, COUNT(*) AS machines
  FROM `tabMetal Server` WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY region
),
rate AS (
  SELECT s.server_id, l.locked_rate, l.currency
  FROM `tabSubscription` s JOIN latest l ON l.subscription = s.name AND l.rn = 1
  WHERE s.enabled = 1 AND s.server_id IS NOT NULL AND s.server_id != '' AND l.change_type != 'Cancelled'
),
servers AS (
  SELECT v.name AS server, v.team, t.team_name, v.region, v.status,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) AS vcpus, COALESCE(v.memory_megabytes, 0) / 1024 AS memory_gib,
    COALESCE(v.disk_gigabytes, 0) AS disk_gib,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabTax Profile` tp WHERE tp.team = v.team AND tp.is_internal = 1) THEN 'Internal'
      WHEN (SELECT MAX(st.trial_state) FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        IN ('Active', 'Ended', 'Deleted') THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabResource Action` ra
          WHERE ra.server = v.name AND ra.action = 'create' AND ra.is_free_trial = 1) THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPayment Method` pm WHERE pm.team = v.team AND pm.status = 'Active')
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabCredit Ledger Entry` e WHERE e.team = v.team AND e.entry_type = 'Credit'
          AND e.reference_type IN ('Top-up', 'Payment Method'))
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabInvoice` i WHERE i.team = v.team AND i.amount_paid > 0) THEN 'Paid'
      ELSE 'Free Credits'
    END AS funding,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) * COALESCE(m.cost / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 0) AS metal_cost_inr,
    COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate,
    COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') AS currency,
    v.atlas_host_id,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') = 'INR' THEN 1
      WHEN r.currency = 'USD' THEN COALESCE((SELECT CAST(value AS DECIMAL(12, 4)) FROM `tabSingles`
        WHERE doctype = 'Billing Settings' AND field = 'reporting_usd_to_inr'), 0)
      ELSE 0 END * COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate_inr
  FROM `tabVirtual Machine` v
  JOIN `tabTeam` t ON t.name = v.team
  LEFT JOIN metal m ON m.region = v.region
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON r.server_id = v.name
  WHERE v.status NOT IN ('Terminated', 'Failed')
)

SELECT ms.region, ms.name AS machine, COUNT(s.server) AS servers,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.vcpus), 0) / NULLIF(ms.vcpus, 0) AS vcpu_used,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.funding = 'Paid' THEN s.list_rate_inr ELSE 0 END), 0)
    - ms.cost_per_month_inr AS profit_inr
FROM `tabMetal Server` ms
LEFT JOIN servers s ON s.atlas_host_id = ms.atlas_host_id AND ms.atlas_host_id IS NOT NULL
WHERE ms.status = 'Active'
GROUP BY ms.region, ms.name, ms.vcpus, ms.cost_per_month_inr
ORDER BY profit_inr

SELECT bucket, SUM(owed) AS owed FROM (
  SELECT CASE
      WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 0 THEN 'Not due'
      WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 30 THEN '1-30 days late'
      WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60 days late'
      ELSE 'Over 60 days late' END AS bucket,
    expected_collection AS owed
  FROM `tabInvoice`
  WHERE invoice_type = 'Billable' AND status IN ('Open', 'Overdue') AND expected_collection > 0
    AND currency = 'INR'
) aged
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY FIELD(bucket, 'Not due', '1-30 days late', '31-60 days late', 'Over 60 days late')

SELECT bucket, SUM(owed) AS owed FROM (
  SELECT CASE
      WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 0 THEN 'Not due'
      WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 30 THEN '1-30 days late'
      WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 60 THEN '31-60 days late'
      ELSE 'Over 60 days late' END AS bucket,
    expected_collection AS owed
  FROM `tabInvoice`
  WHERE invoice_type = 'Billable' AND status IN ('Open', 'Overdue') AND expected_collection > 0
    AND currency = 'USD'
) aged
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY FIELD(bucket, 'Not due', '1-30 days late', '31-60 days late', 'Over 60 days late')

SELECT DATE(creation) AS day,
  SUM(status = 'Captured') AS captured, SUM(status = 'Failed') AS failed
FROM `tabPayment Attempt`
WHERE creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(status = 'Captured') / NULLIF(SUM(status IN ('Captured', 'Failed')), 0), 4) AS success_rate,
  COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Failed' AND creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 0) AS failed_7_days,
  COALESCE(SUM(creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 0) AS attempts_7_days
FROM `tabPayment Attempt`
WHERE creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'INR' THEN expected_collection ELSE 0 END), 0) AS owed_inr,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'USD' THEN expected_collection ELSE 0 END), 0) AS owed_usd,
  COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Overdue'), 0) AS overdue_invoices,
  COUNT(*) AS unpaid_invoices
FROM `tabInvoice`
WHERE invoice_type = 'Billable' AND status IN ('Open', 'Overdue')

WITH latest AS (

  WHERE s.enabled = 1 AND s.server_id IS NOT NULL AND s.server_id != '' AND l.change_type != 'Cancelled'
),
servers AS (

    CASE

      WHEN (SELECT MAX(st.trial_state) FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        IN ('Active', 'Ended', 'Deleted') THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabResource Action` ra

      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPayment Method` pm WHERE pm.team = v.team AND pm.status = 'Active')
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabCredit Ledger Entry` e WHERE e.team = v.team AND e.entry_type = 'Credit'
          AND e.reference_type IN ('Top-up', 'Payment Method'))
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabInvoice` i WHERE i.team = v.team AND i.amount_paid > 0) THEN 'Paid'
      ELSE 'Free Credits'
    END AS funding,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) * COALESCE(m.cost / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 0) AS metal_cost_inr,
    COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate,
    COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') AS currency,
    v.atlas_host_id,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') = 'INR' THEN 1
      WHEN r.currency = 'USD' THEN COALESCE((SELECT CAST(value AS DECIMAL(12, 4)) FROM `tabSingles`
        WHERE doctype = 'Billing Settings' AND field = 'reporting_usd_to_inr'), 0)
      ELSE 0 END * COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate_inr
  FROM `tabVirtual Machine` v
  JOIN `tabTeam` t ON t.name = v.team
  LEFT JOIN metal m ON m.region = v.region
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON r.server_id = v.name
  WHERE v.status NOT IN ('Terminated', 'Failed')
)
,
metal_region AS (
  SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS machines, SUM(cost_per_month_inr) AS bill, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus,
    SUM(memory_gib) AS memory_gib, SUM(disk_gib) AS disk_gib
  FROM `tabMetal Server` WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY region
),
server_region AS (
  SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS servers,
    SUM(funding = 'Paid') AS paid, SUM(funding = 'Free Credits') AS free_credits,
    SUM(funding = 'Internal') AS internal, SUM(funding = 'Trial') AS trial,
    SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus_used, SUM(memory_gib) AS memory_used, SUM(disk_gib) AS disk_used,
    SUM(CASE WHEN funding = 'Paid' THEN list_rate_inr ELSE 0 END) AS earned_inr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN funding != 'Paid' THEN metal_cost_inr ELSE 0 END) AS given_away
  FROM servers GROUP BY region
),
regions AS (SELECT region FROM metal_region UNION SELECT region FROM server_region)

SELECT r.region,
  COALESCE(m.machines, 0) AS machines, COALESCE(m.bill, 0) AS bill,
  COALESCE(s.earned_inr, 0) AS earned_inr, COALESCE(s.earned_inr, 0) - COALESCE(m.bill, 0) AS profit_inr,
  COALESCE(s.given_away, 0) AS given_away,
  COALESCE(m.vcpus, 0) AS vcpus, COALESCE(s.vcpus_used, 0) AS vcpus_used,
  COALESCE(m.memory_gib, 0) AS memory_gib, COALESCE(s.memory_used, 0) AS memory_used,
  COALESCE(m.disk_gib, 0) AS disk_gib, COALESCE(s.disk_used, 0) AS disk_used,
  COALESCE(s.servers, 0) AS servers, COALESCE(s.paid, 0) AS paid, COALESCE(s.free_credits, 0) AS free_credits,
  COALESCE(s.internal, 0) AS internal, COALESCE(s.trial, 0) AS trial,
  COALESCE(s.vcpus_used, 0) / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0) AS vcpu_used_share,
  COALESCE(s.memory_used, 0) / NULLIF(m.memory_gib, 0) AS memory_used_share,
  COALESCE(s.disk_used, 0) / NULLIF(m.disk_gib, 0) AS disk_used_share
FROM regions r
LEFT JOIN metal_region m ON m.region = r.region
LEFT JOIN server_region s ON s.region = r.region

WITH latest AS (

          AND e.reference_type IN ('Top-up', 'Payment Method'))
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabInvoice` i WHERE i.team = v.team AND i.amount_paid > 0) THEN 'Paid'

    END AS funding,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) * COALESCE(m.cost / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 0) AS metal_cost_inr,

        WHERE doctype = 'Billing Settings' AND field = 'reporting_usd_to_inr'), 0)
      ELSE 0 END * COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate_inr
  FROM `tabVirtual Machine` v
  JOIN `tabTeam` t ON t.name = v.team
  LEFT JOIN metal m ON m.region = v.region
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON r.server_id = v.name
  WHERE v.status NOT IN ('Terminated', 'Failed')

SELECT region, CASE funding WHEN 'Paid' THEN 'Paying customers' WHEN 'Free Credits' THEN 'Customers not paying yet' WHEN 'Internal' THEN 'Our own teams' ELSE 'Free trials' END AS funding, COUNT(*) AS servers
FROM servers GROUP BY region, funding

        IN ('Active', 'Ended', 'Deleted') THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabResource Action` ra
          WHERE ra.server = v.name AND ra.action = 'create' AND ra.is_free_trial = 1) THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPayment Method` pm WHERE pm.team = v.team AND pm.status = 'Active')
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabCredit Ledger Entry` e WHERE e.team = v.team AND e.entry_type = 'Credit'
          AND e.reference_type IN ('Top-up', 'Payment Method'))
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabInvoice` i WHERE i.team = v.team AND i.amount_paid > 0) THEN 'Paid'
      ELSE 'Free Credits'
    END AS funding,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) * COALESCE(m.cost / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 0) AS metal_cost_inr,
    COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate,
    COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') AS currency,
    v.atlas_host_id,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') = 'INR' THEN 1
      WHEN r.currency = 'USD' THEN COALESCE((SELECT CAST(value AS DECIMAL(12, 4)) FROM `tabSingles`
        WHERE doctype = 'Billing Settings' AND field = 'reporting_usd_to_inr'), 0)
      ELSE 0 END * COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate_inr
  FROM `tabVirtual Machine` v
  JOIN `tabTeam` t ON t.name = v.team
  LEFT JOIN metal m ON m.region = v.region
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON r.server_id = v.name
  WHERE v.status NOT IN ('Terminated', 'Failed')
)

SELECT region, team_name, CASE funding WHEN 'Paid' THEN 'Paying customers' WHEN 'Free Credits' THEN 'Customers not paying yet' WHEN 'Internal' THEN 'Our own teams' ELSE 'Free trials' END AS funding,
  SUM(metal_cost_inr) AS cost
FROM servers
GROUP BY region, team_name, funding
ORDER BY cost DESC

SELECT DATE(creation) AS day, MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, creation, processed_at)) AS worst_seconds
FROM `tabWebhook Event`
WHERE status = 'Processed' AND processed_at IS NOT NULL AND creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT c.subscription, c.change_type, c.locked_rate, c.currency,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.subscription ORDER BY c.effective_at DESC, c.creation DESC) AS rn
  FROM `tabSubscription Change` c
  WHERE c.change_type IN ('Created', 'Plan Changed', 'Cancelled')
),
metal AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(cost_per_month_inr) AS cost, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus,
    SUM(memory_gib) AS memory_gib, SUM(disk_gib) AS disk_gib, COUNT(*) AS machines
  FROM `tabMetal Server` WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY region
),
rate AS (
  SELECT s.server_id, l.locked_rate, l.currency
  FROM `tabSubscription` s JOIN latest l ON l.subscription = s.name AND l.rn = 1
  WHERE s.enabled = 1 AND s.server_id IS NOT NULL AND s.server_id != '' AND l.change_type != 'Cancelled'
),
servers AS (
  SELECT v.name AS server, v.team, t.team_name, v.region, v.status,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) AS vcpus, COALESCE(v.memory_megabytes, 0) / 1024 AS memory_gib,
    COALESCE(v.disk_gigabytes, 0) AS disk_gib,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabTax Profile` tp WHERE tp.team = v.team AND tp.is_internal = 1) THEN 'Internal'
      WHEN (SELECT MAX(st.trial_state) FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        IN ('Active', 'Ended', 'Deleted') THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabResource Action` ra
          WHERE ra.server = v.name AND ra.action = 'create' AND ra.is_free_trial = 1) THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPayment Method` pm WHERE pm.team = v.team AND pm.status = 'Active')
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabCredit Ledger Entry` e WHERE e.team = v.team AND e.entry_type = 'Credit'
          AND e.reference_type IN ('Top-up', 'Payment Method'))
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabInvoice` i WHERE i.team = v.team AND i.amount_paid > 0) THEN 'Paid'
      ELSE 'Free Credits'
    END AS funding,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) * COALESCE(m.cost / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 0) AS metal_cost_inr,
    COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate,
    COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') AS currency,
    v.atlas_host_id,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') = 'INR' THEN 1
      WHEN r.currency = 'USD' THEN COALESCE((SELECT CAST(value AS DECIMAL(12, 4)) FROM `tabSingles`
        WHERE doctype = 'Billing Settings' AND field = 'reporting_usd_to_inr'), 0)
      ELSE 0 END * COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate_inr
  FROM `tabVirtual Machine` v
  JOIN `tabTeam` t ON t.name = v.team
  LEFT JOIN metal m ON m.region = v.region
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON r.server_id = v.name
  WHERE v.status NOT IN ('Terminated', 'Failed')
)
,
metal_region AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(cost_per_month_inr) AS bill FROM `tabMetal Server` WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY region
),
used AS (
  SELECT region, CASE funding WHEN 'Paid' THEN 'Paying customers' WHEN 'Free Credits' THEN 'Customers not paying yet'
    WHEN 'Internal' THEN 'Our own teams' ELSE 'Free trials' END AS use_type, SUM(metal_cost_inr) AS cost
  FROM servers GROUP BY region, use_type
)
SELECT region, use_type, cost FROM used
UNION ALL
SELECT m.region, 'Unused capacity', GREATEST(m.bill - COALESCE(SUM(u.cost), 0), 0)
FROM metal_region m LEFT JOIN used u ON u.region = m.region
GROUP BY m.region, m.bill
